subject: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace integration — next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@cloudbridge.io>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: priya.singh@cloudbridge.io
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Partner-led discovery recap + proposed next step (technical deep dive)

Hi Marissa —

Great to speak earlier today. Thanks for the overview of Redwood's Dedicated and Private options — the CloudBridge marketplace team is excited about the potential for a tighter integration, especially around onboarding and joint GTM.

As discussed, next step from our side is a partner-led technical deep dive geared toward our engineering and platform teams. Proposed scope:
- Integration patterns for marketplace listing and private deployments
- Authentication and SSO/KMS flows
- Typical performance/latency expectations and quantization profiles
- Operational runbooks (billing handoff, incident escalation)

We'd like to schedule a 60-minute deep dive the week of Mar 11. Working windows on our side (PST):
- Thu Mar 11: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Fri Mar 12: 10:00–12:00 (preferred)

Attached is a draft agenda (draft-agenda.pdf) — feel free to update. If you can confirm a time that works for Redwood, we'll send a calendar invite and include our engineering leads (Priya will be on the call).

Additionally, it would help to get any network diagrams or SSO details we should review beforehand.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Jordan Reed
Partnerships, CloudBridge
[jordan.reed@cloudbridge.io]

Attachment: draft-agenda.pdf (agenda stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 00:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery recap + proposed next step (technical deep dive)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks — great talking with you as well. Fri Mar 12 10:00–11:00 PST works for our team. Can you send the invite for that slot and include Camila (partner ops) and Mateo (solutions engineer) so we can make sure the right folks are on the call?

Prep notes from our side:
- Mateo will own the discussion on onboarding/installation and runtime requirements.
- Camila will cover marketplace listing workflow and commercial handoffs.
- I'll cover high-level architecture and availability/SLA expectations.

I'll paste a quick list of pre-read items for your engineering leads: network topology, SSO provider config (SAML/OIDC), and any required ACLs. If you can drop those into the Google doc (link below) ahead of the call, Mateo can triage.

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-cloudbridge-integration-agenda

>

Marissa —

Confirmed: Fri Mar 12, 2026 10:00–11:00 PST. Invite sent (see calendar link below) and Priya will be on the call along with our integration lead (A. Patel).

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cloudbridge-deep-dive

I've attached a short checklist that outlines what we'll expect from Redwood ahead of the call (cloudbridge-integration-checklist.xlsx). Key asks:
- Network diagram / firewall rules
- SSO provider metadata (SAML certificate or OIDC discovery endpoint)
- Preferred model variants and latency targets for initial pilot

If you prefer, we can do a quick 15-minute sync with Mateo pre-call to validate the environment.

Thanks — Jordan

Subject: Internal: CloudBridge deep dive prep (Fri 10:00 PST)

Team —

Thanks for moving quickly on this. Quick internal checklist before the Fri deep dive (owners below):

- Mateo: confirm sample deployment/infra notes and be ready to discuss quantization options and expected throughput for 10k QPS pilot (prep doc in our Drive).
- Camila: confirm marketplace listing requirements and commercial handoff; have a short slide outlining the submission & review timeline.
- Marissa: I'll lead the call and surface the SLA/rollout options; I'll also confirm the agenda with Jordan.

Let's do a 15-minute sync tomorrow (Thu) at 11:30 PST if that works for you both. I'll send a separate invite.

Marissa

> Jordan confirmed the invite for Fri Mar 12 10:00–11:00 PST and attached the integration checklist.
